estimates.method: Post-MVP effort = sum of auditor estimates per canonical capability. Capabilities built on a shared root engine are multiplied by 0.8 (assumption: the engine is built once and members reuse it). Calendar adds the MVP calendar to post-MVP effort spread over 4.5 parallel tracks (5 days/week), with the same FAST ×1.0 / EXPECTED ×1.5 / RISK ×2.2 factors.

FULL_SITE00.definition: CLIENT_READY_MVP + GROUND_ZERO_FOUNDATION + POST_FIRST_CLIENT_HIGH_PRIORITY. This is the product the founder described: sellable, launchable, measurable, maintainable.

MATURE_PLATFORM.definition: FULL_SITE00 + MATURE_PLATFORM (client reports, CMS, publishing, project graph, infrastructure control plane, client-funded production).

ground_zero_full_for_comparison.why_different: The Ground Zero full plan covered the page tree and the client/workspace loop only. The genome also counts the business pipeline the founder named (offer, payments, CRM, marketing, SEO, analytics, release, maintenance, evolution) that Ground Zero did not estimate.

sequencing_rules: Build each root engine once, then attach capabilities to it. Never build a second registry, ledger or auth path.
CONNECT and REPAIR before ADD. A built-but-unwired capability is promoted before a new one is started.
Nothing in P2/P3 starts while a P0/P1 engine it depends on is EXISTS_PARTIAL.
